data.one_liner: A platform-independent package for parsing and serializing HTTP formats.
data.what_it_does: It provides tools to parse and format HTTP dates, media types (like Accept and Content-Type headers), and other HTTP-related formats. It avoids referencing dart:io or dart:html so it can run on both browser and server.
use_when: You need to parse or serialize HTTP header values like Content-Type or media types.
You are writing a cross-platform web and server application that needs to handle HTTP formats without depending on dart:io.
avoid_when: You are looking for a full HTTP client library to make network requests.
You need WebSocket channel implementations (which have been moved to web_socket_channel).
strengths: Platform-independent, works on both browser and server.
Reliable parsing and formatting for standard HTTP formats and media types.
weaknesses: Limited in scope, strictly handles HTTP parsing and serialization formats rather than networking requests.
